description_en: Invoke the TransferCallToSkillGroup API to execute a single-step or two-step transfer to a skill group
description_zh: 调用TransferCallToSkillGroup接口执行单/双步转交到技能组
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs transfer-call-to-skill-group --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --skill-group-id 356543 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransferCallToSkillGroup

parameters.help_en: Unique ID for the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. It is unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The jobId in the WebSocket after an inbound call
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The connId in the WebSocket after an inbound call
parameters.name: connection_id

parameters.help_en: The holdConnId in the WebSocket after an inbound call (required only for two-step transfer)
parameters.help_zh: 呼入后，websocket中的holdConnId（仅在双步转时传入）
parameters.name: hold_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
Default value: 1. Valid values:
1: Single-step transfer.
2: Two-step transfer
parameters.help_zh:
默认值为1。取值：
1：单步转。
2：双步转
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Default value: true. Valid values:
true: Single-step transfer.
false: Two-step transfer
parameters.help_zh:
默认值为true，取值：
true：单步转。
false：双步转
parameters.name: is_single_transfer

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
